sloka: राघवेणाभये दत्ते सन्नता रावणानुजः ।विभीषणो महापाज्ञो भूमिं समवलोकयन् ।खात्पपातावनीं हृष्टो भक्तैरनुचरैः सह ।। ६.१९.१ ।।।।
transliteration: rāghaveṇābhaye datte sannatā rāvaṇānujaḥ ।vibhīṣaṇo mahāpājño bhūmiṁ samavalokayan ।khātpapātāvanīṁ hṛṣṭo bhaktairanucaraiḥ saha ।। 6.19.1 ।।।।

translations.english: When wise Vibheeshana, the brother of Ravana was assured of security by Raghava, he looked around the ground and prepared (to descend).
